text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, heh.
...Heh, heh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant! Pant, pant!
Pant, pant! Pant, pant...!*

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Hurry, hurry, hurry...!
A glittering, roaring ovation. The world's greatest Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(And I'll be the one to kick it off!
I'll show 'em in the Shuka Sho...!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Ti... me! How is it?

Looking at the stopwatch as urged,
it displays a new personal best time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
!
Ha, haha! Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ALRIGHTTTTT!!
—And so arrived the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"The throne of a strong, noble princess
is something I will never yield to anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am none other than!
The strongest, fastest Kawakami—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fans
text_block_list.text: Princeeess!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
Thank you so much!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Enveloped in thunderous cheers,
here is Kawakami Princess!"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Her power in storming onto the Tiara trail undefeated is impressive enough, but perhaps her popularity stems from that unique character of hers.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Now, the other Umamusume are also receiving
plenty of cheers—and oh, look at that,
someone's striking a pose with a blown kiss!
(Uwoooooah...!!)
In contrast to the roaring racetrack, Fusaichi Pandora remained quiet.

Is it nerves, I wonder?
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say I've staked this whole summer on this single day.

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text: FUSAICHI PAAAANDOOORAAA!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Pandora! Pandora!
Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pandora can do it.
She's a genius, so she can do it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Shining brighter than anyone and stealing every single gaze!
I'll become the greatest, unprecedented queen in history—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡
...Well, you better keep your eyes on me, okay?

"Today marks the dawn of her dream.
The 'Shuka Sho' begins."
